fullPassage:
Dear Connexa Point Table Tennis Center members,
I am the manager of the Connexa Point Table Tennis Center. Thank you for your interest in the upcoming reopening of the center. Unfortunately, during the repair process, unexpected electrical issues were discovered, causing the work to take longer than we planned. We regret to inform you that the center's reopening must be delayed. The center was originally scheduled to reopen on April 1st. However, it will now reopen on May 1st to ensure the safety of all members. We look forward to seeing you back on the court soon. Thank you for your patience and understanding.
Sincerely,
Manager of the Table Tennis Center

questions.passage:
Dear Connexa Point Table Tennis Center members,
I am the manager of the Connexa Point Table Tennis Center. Thank you for your interest in the (A)[upcoming / departing] reopening of the center. Unfortunately, during the (B)[repair / neglect] process, unexpected electrical issues were discovered, causing the work to take longer than we planned. We regret to inform you that the center's reopening must be (C)[delayed / hastened]. The center was originally scheduled to reopen on April 1st. However, it will now reopen on May 1st to ensure the safety of all members.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① upcoming — repair — delayed: 원문 그대로 일치
❌ ② departing(떠나는): upcoming의 반의어
❌ ③ neglect(방치): repair의 반의어
❌ ④ hastened(앞당겨진): delayed의 반의어

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 재개장에 대한 관심(interest), 예상치 못한(unexpected) 전기 문제, 안전을 보장(ensure).
det.analysis:
❌ ① indifference(무관심): interest의 반의어
❌ ② anticipated(예상된): unexpected의 반의어
✅ ③ interest — unexpected — ensure: 원문 일치
❌ ④ jeopardize(위험에 빠뜨리다): ensure의 반의어

questions.passage: The center was originally scheduled to reopen on April 1st. However, it will now reopen on May 1st to ensure the ____ of all members. We look forward to seeing you back on the court soon.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어 (safe)를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.analysis: the + 명사 + of 구조. safe(형용사) → safety(명사: 안전)
det.tip:
the + [명사] + of 구조 → 형용사를 명사로 변환
safe(형) → safety(명)

questions.passage: We regret to inform you that the center's reopening must be delayed. The center was ____ scheduled to reopen on April 1st. However, it will now reopen on May 1st to ensure the safety of all members.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어 (origin)를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: was __(origin) scheduled → 동사 수식 부사 필요: origin → originally.
det.analysis: 과거분사 scheduled를 수식 → 부사 필요. origin(명사) → originally(부사)
det.tip:
동사/과거분사 수식 → 부사
origin(명) → original(형) → originally(부)
